en.flight_search: flight search agent - Search for flight information and tickets.
en.hotel_recommendation: hotel accommodation recommendation agent - Recommend accommodation information (including hotels, B&Bs, and short-term rentals).
en.movie_recommendation: movie recommendation agent - Movie recommendation agent, recommends currently showing movies based on user interests.
en.news_search: news search agent - News search agent, searches for news content related to keywords.
en.restaurant_recommendation: restaurant recommendation agent - Restaurant recommendation agent, recommends restaurants based on location and taste.
en.itinerary_planning: Itinerary Planning Agent - Plan structured multi-day travel itineraries with clear daily and time-based schedules
en.weather_forecast_inquiry: inquiry weather forecast according to the date and city.
en.chat_agent: chat agent - Conversational chat agent for open dialogue, multi-turn clarification and conversational assistance.
